submit_topic.why_now: Demo fixture: Skills let people stop re-pasting the same instructions, a recurring pain point in AI tutorials.

facts.fact: A Claude skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file with instructions, optionally plus scripts and resources.
SKILL.md starts with a name and a description; Claude uses the description to decide when to load the skill.
Only the short description sits in context until a request matches; the full skill loads on demand.

submit_script.title: Stop re-pasting prompts: Claude Skills in 40 seconds

segments.voiceover: Stop pasting the same instructions into Claude every day.
Turn them into a skill. A skill is just a folder with a file called SKILL dot M D.
At the top, a name and a one-line description. Below it, your steps.
segments.code:
---
name: weekly-report
description: Turn my notes
  into our weekly report
---
1. Pull wins, risks, asks
2. Use the team template
3. Keep it under 200 words

segments.voiceover: Claude reads only that description until your request matches it. Then it loads the whole skill.
So you can keep dozens of skills without bloating a single chat.
Follow for a new Claude trick every day.

submit_script.caption: Write your instructions once, reuse them forever. Here's how Claude Skills load.
